name: GetOpenDebts
description: Read-only. A customer's open documents as of a date: the customer's OpenMovements rows (Priority's unmatched movements per due month – invoices, credit notes, receipts on account; the same source as the aging and the notes engine, never Invoices.openAmount) with due date, days overdue, open amount, and the original amount / movement type / details from the LedgerEntries row of the same document; totals (open, overdue, not yet due), the end-of-card balance (last LedgerEntries running balance, else Customers.ledgerBalance), and open receipts not yet matched (bank lines of the customer whose proposal is not decided). source is always OpenMovements; movementsMirrorEmpty = true when the whole OpenMovements table is empty (the pull never ran): the documents are unknown, not zero. The same builder feeds the open-debts PDF. Writes nothing.

movementsMirrorEmpty.description: True when the OpenMovements table is empty (pull never ran / failed)
